UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; cd \"$BASE\"; if [ ! -f minqlx.x64.so ] && [ ! -f minqlx.x86.so ]; then cd \"$ROOT\"; rm -rf minqlx_build; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/MinoMino/minqlx.git minqlx_build; cd minqlx_build; PYCONFIG=$(ls /usr/bin/python3.*-config 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n \"$PYCONFIG\" ]; then mkdir -p .path && ln -sf \"$PYCONFIG\" .path/python3-config && export PATH=\"$PWD/.path:$PATH\"; mkdir -p include; for d in /usr/include/python3.*; do [ -d \"$d\" ] && ln -sfn \"$d\" \"include/$(basename $d)\" && break; done; fi; make; cp -f bin/* \"$BASE\"; cd \"$ROOT\"; rm -rf minqlx_build; echo minqlx built; else echo minqlx already present, skipping build; fi; cd \"$BASE\"; if [ ! -d minqlx-plugins ] || [ ! -d minqlx-plugins/.git ]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/MinoMino/minqlx-plugins.git; export PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1; python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r minqlx-plugins/requirements.txt -q; echo minqlx-plugins installed; else echo minqlx-plugins already present, skipping; fi; echo minqlx and plugins ready"
-c "redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG && exit 0 || redis-server --daemonize yes"
-c "timeout=15; while ((timeout--)); do redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'Redis failed to start'; exit 1"
